# SiliconMetaTrader5

> SiliconMetaTrader5 runs MetaTrader 5 (MT5) for Python code outside Windows: on macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4 and Intel), on Linux x86_64, and on your own Linux or Windows servers over SSH. A desktop app installs and supervises the MT5 terminal and a local RPyC bridge; the Python package `siliconmetatrader5` exposes the same functions, parameters and return values as MetaQuotes' official `MetaTrader5` package, so existing MT5 Python code changes only its connection line.

Key facts:

- Python: `pip install siliconmetatrader5`, then `from siliconmetatrader5 import MetaTrader5; mt5 = MetaTrader5(host="127.0.0.1", port=8001); mt5.initialize()`.
- Same API as the official package: initialize, account_info, terminal_info, symbol_info, symbol_info_tick, copy_rates_from_pos, copy_rates_from, copy_rates_range, copy_ticks_from, order_send, order_check, positions_get, orders_get, history_deals_get, history_orders_get, and the TIMEFRAME_* / ORDER_* constants.
- macOS: Mac native mode (Wine 11 under Rosetta 2, no VM) or Safe mode (Docker in an x86_64 QEMU VM). Install with `brew tap bahadirumutiscimen/siliconmt5 https://github.com/bahadirumutiscimen/silicon-metatrader5 && brew trust bahadirumutiscimen/siliconmt5 && brew install siliconmt5`.
- Linux x86_64: Linux native mode (Wine 11) or Docker; `.deb` and `.AppImage` on GitHub Releases.
- Servers: Linux (native or Docker) and Windows (native MT5) VPS managed over SSH; an encrypted SSH tunnel connects local code; bots can also run on the server itself, 24/7.
- Security: every port listens on 127.0.0.1; the app never reads or stores passwords.
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Personal and other noncommercial use is free; commercial use needs a license from the author.
- Broker time: bar and tick times are on the broker's server clock; use `server_now(mt5)` for ranges that end now.
- Measured on an Apple M4, v1.2 (Docker/QEMU) → v1.3 (Mac native): startup 55.2 s → 20.3 s, bridge round trip 10.96 ms → 0.8 ms, 10,000 bars 1.10 s → 0.03 s.
